items.name: Oscietra Caviar (30g)
items.editorialDescription: A refined Oscietra caviar with a silky texture, delicate salinity and lingering buttery finish.
items.chefStory: Presented traditionally to allow the purity of the caviar to remain the centrepiece of the experience.
items.ingredientStory: Harvested from premium Oscietra sturgeon using sustainable farming techniques.

items.name: Gillardeau Oysters No.2
items.editorialDescription: The world's most celebrated oyster, prized for remarkable sweetness and clean mineral notes.
items.chefStory: Served simply with citrus to highlight the natural character of the oyster.
items.ingredientStory: Raised in the Gillardeau family's renowned oyster beds on the Atlantic coast.

items.name: Hokkaido Scallops
items.editorialDescription: Naturally sweet scallops with a delicate texture and exceptional freshness.
items.chefStory: Lightly seared to preserve the sweetness and buttery consistency.
items.ingredientStory: Harvested from the pristine cold waters surrounding Hokkaido.

items.name: Bluefin Tuna Tataki
items.editorialDescription: Lightly seared bluefin tuna showcasing exceptional marbling and purity.
items.chefStory: Finished with delicate seasoning to celebrate the fish rather than overpower it.
items.ingredientStory: Premium-grade Bluefin selected from trusted Japanese suppliers.

items.name: Japanese A5 Wagyu Strip
items.editorialDescription: The pinnacle of beef, celebrated for extraordinary marbling and unmatched richness.
items.chefStory: Prepared with minimal intervention so every slice delivers the authentic Wagyu experience.
items.ingredientStory: Certified A5 Miyazaki Wagyu raised under strict Japanese grading standards.

items.name: 45-Day Dry-Aged Tomahawk
items.editorialDescription: An intensely flavoured tomahawk matured for forty-five days to develop remarkable depth.
items.chefStory: Slow-fired over premium charcoal before resting to maximise tenderness.
items.ingredientStory: Selected from premium Australian Black Angus cattle.

items.name: Australian Full-Blood Wagyu Ribeye
items.editorialDescription: Full-blood Wagyu offering luxurious marbling balanced with a rich beef character.
items.chefStory: Expertly grilled to produce a crisp exterior while preserving a buttery interior.
items.ingredientStory: Raised on carefully managed Australian Wagyu farms using premium feeding programs.

items.name: Whole Maine Lobster
items.editorialDescription: Sweet, succulent Atlantic lobster celebrated for its delicate texture and luxurious flavour.
items.chefStory: Steamed gently before being finished over charcoal with cultured butter and herbs.
items.ingredientStory: Wild-caught from the cold waters off the coast of Maine, ensuring exceptional sweetness and freshness.

items.name: Alaskan King Crab Legs
items.editorialDescription: Extraordinary king crab renowned for naturally sweet meat and impressive presentation.
items.chefStory: Prepared with restraint so the natural sweetness remains the highlight of every bite.
items.ingredientStory: Harvested sustainably from the icy waters of Alaska.

items.name: Chilean Sea Bass
items.editorialDescription: Rich, buttery sea bass with a silky texture and beautifully clean finish.
items.chefStory: Slow roasted to preserve moisture while creating a perfectly caramelised surface.
items.ingredientStory: Responsibly sourced from deep Southern Ocean waters.

items.name: Dom Pérignon Vintage 2013
items.editorialDescription: An iconic vintage Champagne combining elegance, freshness and remarkable complexity.
items.chefStory: Recommended for milestone celebrations and refined seafood pairings.
items.ingredientStory: Produced exclusively from Grand Cru vineyards in Champagne.

items.name: Krug Grande Cuvée
items.editorialDescription: An exceptionally layered prestige cuvée offering richness, finesse and remarkable depth.
items.chefStory: Served in oversized crystal stemware to fully express its bouquet.
items.ingredientStory: Crafted from more than one hundred reserve wines spanning multiple vintages.

items.name: Louis Roederer Cristal
items.editorialDescription: Silky, vibrant and exceptionally refined with extraordinary ageing potential.
items.chefStory: One of our cellar's signature Champagnes for truly memorable occasions.
items.ingredientStory: Produced only during exceptional vintages from estate-owned vineyards.

items.name: Bollinger La Grande Année
items.editorialDescription: A full-bodied vintage Champagne with remarkable structure and richness.
items.chefStory: An outstanding companion to premium shellfish and aged cheeses.
items.ingredientStory: Fermented in oak barrels using traditional Bollinger methods.

items.name: Ruinart Blanc de Blancs
items.editorialDescription: Elegant Chardonnay-driven Champagne with floral aromas and crisp minerality.
items.chefStory: Perfect as an aperitif or alongside delicate seafood dishes.
items.ingredientStory: Crafted predominantly from Premier Cru Chardonnay vineyards.

items.name: Château Margaux 2016
items.editorialDescription: One of Bordeaux's most iconic First Growth wines, celebrated for elegance, perfume and extraordinary ageing potential.
items.chefStory: Reserved for guests seeking one of the world's finest expressions of Cabernet Sauvignon.
items.ingredientStory: Produced from meticulously maintained vineyards in the prestigious Margaux appellation.

items.name: Château Lafite Rothschild 2015
items.editorialDescription: A legendary Bordeaux combining remarkable finesse, structure and exceptional depth.
items.chefStory: Our sommeliers recommend this exceptional vintage with premium Wagyu and dry-aged beef.
items.ingredientStory: Produced by one of the world's oldest and most respected wine estates.

items.name: Opus One 2018
items.editorialDescription: An iconic Napa Valley blend offering richness, balance and refined complexity.
items.chefStory: Chosen for guests seeking a modern luxury wine with exceptional international recognition.
items.ingredientStory: A collaboration between Baron Philippe de Rothschild and Robert Mondavi.

items.name: Sassicaia 2019
items.editorialDescription: The original Super Tuscan, admired for elegance, freshness and beautifully integrated tannins.
items.chefStory: Recommended for guests exploring Italian fine wines at their highest expression.
items.ingredientStory: Produced from the historic Tenuta San Guido estate overlooking the Tuscan coast.

items.name: Penfolds Grange 2017
items.editorialDescription: Australia's most celebrated luxury wine, renowned for power, longevity and extraordinary richness.
items.chefStory: Presented to collectors and connoisseurs seeking one of the Southern Hemisphere's greatest wines.
items.ingredientStory: Produced from carefully selected Shiraz vineyards across South Australia.

items.name: The Macallan 18 Double Cask
items.editorialDescription: A luxurious single malt matured in American and European oak sherry-seasoned casks, delivering notes of dried fruit, toffee and warm spice.
items.chefStory: Served in crystal with a hand-cut ice sphere to highlight its rich aromas and silky finish.
items.ingredientStory: Crafted at The Macallan Distillery using exceptional oak casks that define its unmistakable character.

items.name: Glenfiddich 21 Gran Reserva
items.editorialDescription: An exceptional single malt finished in Caribbean rum casks, delivering layers of toffee, fig and warming spice.
items.chefStory: Recommended after dinner as a luxurious digestif served in crystal glassware.
items.ingredientStory: Aged for twenty-one years before an extended Caribbean rum cask finish.

items.name: Hibiki 21
items.editorialDescription: A beautifully balanced Japanese whisky offering delicate floral aromas, honeyed sweetness and extraordinary depth.
items.chefStory: One of the rarest whiskies on our list, reserved for collectors and enthusiasts.
items.ingredientStory: A meticulous blend of aged malt and grain whiskies matured in multiple cask types.

items.name: Johnnie Walker Blue Label
items.editorialDescription: An iconic luxury blend delivering remarkable smoothness with notes of dark chocolate, smoke and dried fruit.
items.chefStory: A timeless classic enjoyed neat or with a single crystal-clear ice sphere.
items.ingredientStory: Created from some of Scotland's rarest whisky reserves.

items.name: Lagavulin 16
items.editorialDescription: A legendary Islay whisky celebrated for bold peat smoke, maritime character and extraordinary complexity.
items.chefStory: Recommended for guests who appreciate robust smoky whiskies.
items.ingredientStory: Slowly matured for sixteen years beside the rugged Scottish coastline.

items.name: Valrhona Chocolate Soufflé
items.editorialDescription: An airy Valrhona chocolate soufflé with a molten centre and intense cocoa finish.
items.chefStory: Prepared to order and baked individually for every guest.
items.ingredientStory: Made using premium Valrhona chocolate sourced from France's most celebrated chocolatier.

items.name: Vanilla Bean Crème Brûlée
items.editorialDescription: Silky Madagascan vanilla custard finished with a perfectly caramelised sugar crust.
items.chefStory: Caramelised moments before serving for the perfect crack with every spoon.
items.ingredientStory: Prepared using whole Madagascan vanilla beans and fresh cream.

items.name: Artisan Cheese Selection
items.editorialDescription: A curated selection of exceptional artisan cheeses served with seasonal accompaniments.
items.chefStory: Personally selected by our chef to conclude the dining experience with elegance.
items.ingredientStory: Featuring hand-crafted cheeses from renowned European producers.
